title: C3 stage 9 (#15204): declared sharing rules read from the registry, bootstrapDeclaredSharingRules retires, and the ceremony deletes the declared-rule mirrors; the verified marker follows (director ordering ruling)
body:
Part of #15204 (C3, ADR-0131). Filing gate: **④ a ruled execution card** — the director's ordering ruling the record whose id is the first line of #15204's body on #15204 (batch #357 item 3, the maintainer's 「总监裁顺序」), under the stage-0 addendum 6100442578 (「If stages 1–8 land while stage 9 is still gated, stage 9 moves to its own card under the epic」). Filed by the director seat (summon #43, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`). ⛔ Not a claim. `pm:epic`: the epic PM dispatches it. Facts were read at objectstack `origin/main` `099cc9d6`.

## The order (ruled)

Stage 9 goes first; the ownership ceremony's verified marker is reached after it. ADR-0131 D13/D14's zero-NULL gate is read as satisfied by a D10 report whose only remaining NULL rows are the `declared-rule-mirrors` the ceremony itself charts for this stage; any other NULL row keeps blocking both the marker and this stage.

## The work

1. **Registry read.** Declared `sharingRules` are served from the registry at enforcement. `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-rule-service.ts` (`listRules`, `getRule`, `findRuleRowByName`, the orphan sweep) reads declared rules from the registry and organization-authored rules from `sys_sharing_rule`; the recipient and condition shapes are reconciled (the registry copy and the metadata-door copy differ today: recipient `'role'`, condition string versus `{dialect, source}` — `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-seeder-declaration-copy.test.ts`). Measure first: whether a reader like `createSecurityCatalogReader` for `sharing_rule` needs `sharing_rule` to become a registered metadata kind (the addendum's item (a) — `packages/spec` work for the spec seat, `Blocked-by:` this card if so).
2. **Seeder retired.** `bootstrapDeclaredSharingRules` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/bootstrap-declared-sharing-rules.ts`, called from `sharing-plugin.ts`) stops running; its retirement note is written where D13 asks (the seeder is machinery, not an authorable shape, so the ADR-0087 entry is the note).
3. **`sys_record_share.source_id` → name** BEFORE any deletion (the addendum's item (c)): grants that point at a declared rule's row id are rewritten to the rule's name and verified to resolve in the registry.
4. **Mirrors deleted.** The ceremony deletes `sys_sharing_rule` rows with `managed_by in (package, platform)` and `customized` not true — the `mirror-deletion` departure made executable on the fate-3 table, or this stage's own idempotent migration step; the executor chooses and pins either way. After it, `remainingFor` reaches 0 on `sys_sharing_rule` and the ceremony's post-check can verify.
5. **Text.** The post-check label for `declared-rule-mirrors` names this card.

## Pins

- A fresh boot in every posture writes zero rows to `sys_sharing_rule` for declared rules, and a declared rule still enforces (positive control: remove the declaration and the grant stops).
- On a database that completed the ceremony with the mirror rows standing (the maintainer's hotcrm `dev.db`: 11 rows), this stage's step deletes exactly those rows, every `sys_record_share.source_id` resolves by name, and the post-check reports zero remaining; a customized or organization-authored rule is untouched.
- An organization-authored rule keeps working through `sys_sharing_rule` in every posture.

## Decision owed, maybe

The addendum's item (b): what switching off a vendor's declared rule means under D6 (no regime charted for this type). If ADR-0131 D6 and ADR-0057 D6 do not settle it when this stage is planned, the epic PM files a decision card; it does not block items 2–5.

## Governing text

ADR-0131 D2 (the seeder retires), D10 fate 2, D13 (`:673`), D14 (`:697`); the stage-0 addendum 6100442578; the ordering ruling the record whose id is the first line of #15204's body on #15204; ADR-0057 D6 (the runtime shape is canonical).

## Dedupe

Open `target:v18` cards whose title or body names stage 9, `bootstrapDeclaredSharingRules` or declared sharing rules at filing: #15204 only (REST list of 100 open). Dedupe words: C3 stage 9 declared sharing rules registry bootstrapDeclaredSharingRules retire declared-rule-mirrors ceremony verified marker.
